knowledge_gaps: The proposed comparisons omit a residual-only variant using baseline BCE. A four-way comparison—baseline, objective-only, residual-only, combined—is needed to distinguish architectural gains from loss changes.

A sigmoid bounds the gate but does not bound the residual contribution: item-embedding norms may grow relative to normalized SASRec states. Specify representation scaling, decay parameterization, padding masks, short-history handling, and whether pooling includes the current visible item.

The sampled-softmax objective needs an explicit formula, temperature, treatment of sampling probabilities, and handling of variable negative counts or empty eligible pools. Chunking must preserve the joint softmax denominator.

Recent-item similarity could amplify recently satisfied purchases or broad associations. The report needs a fixed-recency baseline and evidence that the learned gate contributes beyond score scaling. Originality is reasonably rated as incremental; potential and difficulty ratings remain uncertain without these controls and runtime measurements.

No baseline validation HR@10, checkpoint-selection schedule, or concrete GPU-budget allocation is provided. With 200 validation users per category, small gains and repeated checkpoint selection require uncertainty analysis. The required simulator evaluation on twenty training users is also absent from the experimental procedure.
